name: tickit
//: drizzle-orm is hoisted here so drizzle-kit (also hoisted) can resolve it. Without this npm nests drizzle-orm under server/ and `drizzle-kit generate` fails.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
